name: alpha-bisabolol
description: Alpha-bisabolol (CAS 72691-24-8 ) is a naturally derived monocyclic sesquiterpene alcohol sourced primarily from chamomile oil, though synthetic and semi-synthetic versions are commercially available. It functions as a skin-conditioning agent, fragrance component, and stabilizer across personal care, pharmaceutical, and food applications. In cosmetic formulations, it is used in moisturizers and serums. The material is a standard active in sensitive-skin product lines due to its soothing properties. Pharmaceutical topical preparations incorporate it as a penetration enhancer and stabilizing agent in creams. In fragrance development, it contributes a mild, floral-woody character and also functions as a fixative. This helps to extend the longevity of more volatile scent components in complex aromatic blends. Food and flavor applications use it at controlled levels as a flavoring agent, particularly in products where a subtle floral note is required. It is supplied as a clear to pale yellow viscous liquid. It is available in natural and synthetic grades, with natural-origin material commanding a premium in clean-label markets. Cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications are the most commonly traded. Purity levels for these industrial grades are typically at 95% or higher.
